entry.summaryHtml: Black tea, peach, cream, pine, herbs and light citrus make Cold Infusion Tea bright, sweet and botanical rather than dark or tobacco-heavy. The smoke should stay soft and creamy, with peach and tea through the middle and a clean herbal-pine finish touched by citrus.
